title: A wedding cake, a political contribution and the Central Subway design rates

beats.text: Fourteen Central Subway design consultants had their overhead schedules reviewed.

visual.sub: Fourteen consultant schedules tested in the first review

beats.text: The auditors recommended lower rates for ten. They accepted four.

visual.kicker: Fourteen consultant schedules tested in the first review

visual.label: Fourteen consultant schedules tested in the first review

beats.text: One account included a political campaign contribution and a wedding cake.

visual.kicker: A political contribution and a personal trip entered an overhead schedule

beats.text: The travel review also identified a personal trip to Great Britain.

visual.kicker: A political contribution and a personal trip entered an overhead schedule

beats.text: The auditors removed $58,481 from the miscellaneous account alone.

visual.label: A political contribution and a personal trip entered an overhead schedule

beats.text: A second review found reductions for all five consultants it examined.

visual.kicker: A second cohort mixed direct project costs into the shared pool

visual.label: A second cohort mixed direct project costs into the shared pool

beats.text: More than half came from direct project costs classified as shared overhead.

visual.kicker: A second cohort mixed direct project costs into the shared pool
visual.text: Direct costs in the shared pool

beats.text: In April 2014, the Controller reported all five recommendations closed.

visual.kicker: The review tracked rates separately from recovery

beats.text: The final contract calculation depends on the payroll billed at each rate.

visual.kicker: The review tracked rates separately from recovery

beats.text: The follow-up gives no final credit or refund amount.

visual.kicker: The review tracked rates separately from recovery
